steps.body:
A tree with $n$ vertices has $n-1$ edges, so $\xi=2(n-1)$.

$\xi(S)=\xi(T)\Rightarrow 2(|S|-1)=2(|T|-1)\Rightarrow |S|=|T|$ (here $|S|$ = number of vertices).
